constraints.text: Do not add spoken or sung lines.

claims.text: Rain runs down a bus window at night while the city slides past outside.
The bus interior is shadowed and nearly empty; a pale handrail and dim seat backs appear faintly in the window reflection.
The raindrops catch amber, magenta and sodium-white city light, while condensation gathers along the lower edge of the glass.
Outside, streetlights and lit shopfronts stretch into horizontal color smears as the bus travels.

style: Cinematic live-action night photography, vertical 9:16 framing, shallow depth of field with the raindrops tack-sharp and the city dissolved into soft neon bokeh, deep blue-black shadows against warm amber and magenta highlights, wet glass reflections, fine 35mm grain, natural handheld-free steadiness, muted contrast with glowing specular highlights on each droplet.

description.text: Night presses close to the glass of a bus window. Raindrops bead on the outer pane in dense, trembling clusters, each one holding a tiny curved highlight of amber, magenta and sodium white. Beyond the wet surface, the city is a soft field of neon bokeh, its signs and streetlights blurred into floating color. Condensation furs the lower edge of the frame, and the dark window frame holds the view in a narrow vertical slice.
Rain patters softly against the glass, with a low, muffled bus engine hum beneath it.
A dense field of raindrops trembles on the outer glass; each drop catches a small warm or cool specular point.
One heavy drop swells, quivers and breaks loose, dragging a wavering clear trail through the condensation.
The trail widens into a thin ribbon of clarity, revealing sharper streaks of amber and magenta light behind it.
More drops gather along the fresh path, wobble with the bus's motion and release in slow, uneven runs.
The glass shivers; droplet highlights stretch and jump as the city lights slide beyond the pane.

The pane still dominates the frame, but the shadowed bus interior now reads across it: a faint reflection of the aisle, a pale handrail and the dim suggestion of empty seats. Outside, shopfronts and streetlights travel laterally, pulled into long horizontal smears of gold, pink and icy blue. The rain keeps dividing those streaks into wet, glittering fragments. At the edges of the glass, condensation thickens and catches a last rim of reflected light.
Steady rain continues on the window, undercut by a low engine drone and a brief wet tire hiss from the street.
Faint interior reflections overlay the rain: the aisle's dim shape, a pale handrail and shadowed seat backs.
Outside, lit shopfronts and streetlights slide sideways, their colors stretched into horizontal bands by the bus's travel.
The moving light smears break apart into wet flecks where fresh raindrops cross them.
A cluster of droplets merges and runs down the pane, bending the reflected aisle and the passing neon into rippled lines.
The glass holds a dense mesh of beads and trails as the city's glow pulses softly beyond it.

soundscape: Soft rain pattering on glass; a low, muffled bus engine hum; occasional wet tire hiss from outside.
